places: handover/design/SSE4-galaxy-design.md (5. Gx: one galaxy as a regulated reservoir)
claims: A small system of rate equations per galaxy, stepped on a fixed grid (default 10 Myr, about 1,400 steps for the whole of history; cost is trivial). This is the "bathtub" or "regulator" approach (Bouché et al. 2010; Lilly et al. 2013; Davé et al. 2012).

Regulator model (Bouche et al. 2010; Lilly et al. 2013; Dave, Finlator and Oppenheimer 2012); depletion times Tacconi et al. 2018 and Leroy et al. 2008; winds Muratov et al. 2015; fallback Henriques et al. 2013; hot haloes and radio-mode feedback Croton et al.…
